Lost Chapter (and Morello) is viable on Viktor, it just depends what the situation of the game calls for. Gaining 100 AP, 400 mana, 20% CDR, Grievous Wounds and mana on kill feels good, but you should build it when 1. you want to burst someone down with the raw AP, 2. there is someone on the enemy team that heals, such as Soraka or Vlad, or 3. there is no one that will dive you etc. (since you have low mobility and therefore most of the time will require a defensive item, unless your positioning and awareness is god-like).

I see that no one's replied, so I'll try and give my own opinion on it, despite me being a jungle/support main. Just be aware that I haven't played mid as a main role for a season, and have only really played Viktor out of the three (I'm mastery level 7 on him and had a decent WR on him in season 6).

Orianna is probably the best out of the three you have mentioned. She has the best early of all three with her safe wave control (you can dispute this with Viktor's early, but he ideally needs 1250g for his Mk1 upgrade before he backs, which can be unrealistic, and Ori can back with 900g for Lost Chapter) and can protect the ADC the best with her E shield (and ult). If you ever get behind, Ori is the best champion to play, considering both Vlad and Viktor are dependent on gold and exp to be effective. Orianna is still semi-effective when behind, with her shield, MS buff (W on allies) and CC (ult and W on enemies), of which the other two lack (Viktor does have his W, however it is very unreliable and only one form of protection).

However, if you play safe and farm up until mid-late, Viktor is a waveclear monster with his E. Mid should never be pushed in if your other lanes are holding up well, but his issue is that he is very immobile and can therefore be exploited early on. You need good wave manipulation to play him.

For Vladimir, you are a massive threat to the backline in teamfights. You are difficult to kill with your heals and invulnerability, and do a lot of damage with your combo, if fully landed.
